purpose: Server-authoritative product ownership, receipts, purchases, and gifting.
description: Coordinates Roblox product ownership, purchase receipts, gifting, and server-authoritative product handlers across the network boundary.

GameProductService.luau.description: GameConfig-backed purchase prompting, ownership queries, and receipt-safe developer-product fulfillment. Developer products are granted only from ProcessReceipt through ReceiptProcessingService. PromptProductPurchaseFinished is used only to detect a cancelled prompt.
